question: Should OpenClaw continue this Wave 2+ dashboard roadmap as staged bundled dashboard work, and which subitems should move to plugin, skill, or ClawHub distribution instead?
rationale: The issue spans bundled UI, plugin SDK, persistent state, browser sandbox, command/data-binding, sharing, visibility, and distribution boundaries that automation cannot choose safely for maintainers.

options.title: Keep umbrella, review subitems
options.body: Keep the tracker open, review the linked PRs and subissues in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, and upgrade proof before landing each stage.

options.title: Narrow to extension APIs
options.body: Keep only missing generic plugin/widget SDK seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widgets, skills, galleries, and app bundles to prove themselves through external plugin packages or ClawHub first.

options.title: Pause the roadmap
options.body: Leave the linked implementation stack unmerged and close or defer the roadmap if maintainers do not want bundled dashboard work in the current product cycle.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella, review subitems
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker open, review the linked PRs and subissues in dependency order, and require explicit storage, sandbox, permission, and upgrade proof before landing each stage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main ownership signal is the recently merged plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent that this roadmap builds on.
